title: OmniScan Mezon Bot
description: OmniScan is an automated AI-powered Mezon platform bot written in Go that connects to the mac-ocr proxy backend and LLM AI Agent (qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b). It listens to Mezon chat channels, detects document/image URLs or file attachments, extracts text via OCR, automatically classifies and formats documents, and supports interactive follow-up Q&A directly in chat threads.
